result.topic_en: Pencil calculations on an algebraic equation F(x, x')=0 of degree 2p-2: the exponents of the integrands $dx/(\partial F/\partial x')$ at the points x=0 and x=∞, and the counting of the number r of branch or contact points in terms of p (e.g. $r=(p-1)(2p-2+\mu)-\mu$, $r=4(p-1)(p-2)$), together with the construction of adjoint functions φ, φ_1, … .

methods.what: Local uniformizer behaviour of the differential du at x=0 and x=∞
Count of common solutions of F=0, ∂F/∂x'=0 (branch points) for a curve of bidegree (2μ+2p-2, μ)
General form of integrands of first kind as dx/(∂F/∂x') times polynomial of lowered degree
Branch point count for the curve F(x,x') of degrees (4p-4, 2p-2)
Form of F as polynomial in x'^2 x and its derivative
Relations among adjoint functions φ, φ_1, φ_2 modulo F (Noether-type identities)
Counting arbitrary constants of the adjoint functions
